channel.title: Wahaj Ayub - Research Radar
channel.description: Selected papers in topological photovoltaics, quantum geometry, noncentrosymmetric materials, Hopf phases, and mathematical condensed matter.

item.title: Multidimensional Sensing in Flexible Violet Phosphorus Photodetectors Driven by the Bulk Photovoltaic Effect
item.description: Few-layer violet phosphorus enables a flexible zero-bias photodetector with broadband polarization-sensitive BPVE performance.

item.title: Dissipationless Photovoltaic Spin Hall Effect from Spin-current Vorticity
item.description: Spin-current vorticity produces switchable dissipationless photovoltaic spin Hall currents governed by Berry curvature and quantum metric.

item.title: Spin-selective elliptic optical dichroism and perfectly spin-polarized third-order nonlinear photocurrent in altermagnets
item.description: Elliptical light and a dc field generate a perfectly spin-polarized third-order photocurrent in an inversion-symmetric d-wave altermagnet.

item.title: Axion dark matter detection via shift current
item.description: A strong-field shift-current protocol in TaAs is proposed to downconvert axion-induced signals into an accessible broadband detection channel.

item.title: Domain switching-induced large rigid shift of the bulk photovoltaic effect in (111)-oriented BiFeO3 epitaxial films
item.description: Electric-field-driven domain switching shifts BiFeO3 BPVE curves through interfacial Schottky-barrier changes without changing their amplitude or phase.

item.title: Second-Chern Bounds in Non-Abelian Quantum Geometry
item.description: A determinant bound links non-Abelian quantum metric to four-dimensional curvature and second-Chern density, with saturation yielding quaternion-Kähler structure.
